words.gloss_range: opening connector joining the ayah to the prior refusal scene while launching a contrastive conditional panel
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes 24:49 a linked second panel rather than a fresh start. It carries the prior refusal scene (24:48) into the new condition, so the reader hears a joined contrast: when summoned they turn aside, but if the right is in their favor they come. Its attached onset with the following conditional particle keeps the boundary relation and the conditional trigger compressed into one opening movement.

topics.headline: linked contrast with the prior scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 24:49 is the counterpart to 24:48, not an isolated hypothetical.
topics.reason: The QAC grammar identifies coordination with 24:48, and the CRITICAL rows converge on a joined antithetical panel.

topics.headline: attached connective onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the recited opening fuses connection and condition before the clause develops.
topics.reason: The rows focus on the proclitic form and opening order; no guardrail contradicts the compact connective onset.

words.gloss_range: real conditional particle governing both the condition and response, with the favorable case grammatically contingent
words.prose: {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:ʾin}}) turns the favorable outcome into an if-scenario that governs both following jussive verbs, the condition and its response. The condition is real, not counterfactual, but against the prior when-scene (24:48) it sounds less settled: compliance is modeled as what happens only when the right is on their side. As a compact standalone particle, it is the clean trigger before the dependent verbs begin, making the behavior an if-then output rather than a stable virtue.

topics.headline: scope over condition and response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the whole behavior is grammatically contingent, not merely the first verb.
topics.reason: The clause evidence syntactically forces a condition-apodosis relation, and the CRITICAL rows attach the particle to both jussive verbs.

topics.headline: real possibility, not impossibility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the favorable case is possible but framed less habitually than the prior refusal scene (24:48).
topics.reason: The rows contrast the conditional with the prior temporal frame; QAC confirms a real condition, so the topic is narrowed away from impossibility or rarity as a hard claim.

topics.headline: visible jussive trigger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the particle as a clean trigger before the dependent verbs begin.
topics.reason: The compact standalone particle and following jussive forms are directly supported by the grammar rows.

words.gloss_range: apocopated copular being-verb in the protasis; tests whether the right obtains for them
words.root_gloss_range: being, occurrence, and predication are the active range; formation, making, place, suretyship, submission, and idiomatic branches are not locally selected
words.prose: {{ar:يَكُنْ}} ({{tr:yakun}}) does not say that truth simply exists; as a copula it binds a fronted beneficiary predicate to the delayed subject, and its singular agreement points to the right rather than the plural group. Its clipped jussive form keeps that state inside the if-frame: if the right obtains for them, then they come. The broad being-root is narrowed here to non-causative predication in a legal-discourse setting, so the group are not makers of the right; they respond when it turns out in their favor.

topics.headline: being tied to advantage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb makes right obtain for a party, not merely exist in abstraction.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the predicate and subject, supporting the CRITICAL claim that the being-verb is locally copular and beneficiary-oriented.

topics.headline: apocopated conditional verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shortened verb as the grammatical mark that the favorable state is dependent on the condition.
topics.reason: QAC confirms jussive apocopation under the conditional particle; the acoustic row is retained as a secondary payoff of the same clipped dependency.

topics.headline: singular agreement with the right
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the singular verb points to the right as subject, not to the plural group.
topics.reason: The subject attachment and 3ms morphology directly support this local parsing point.

topics.headline: being range narrowed to obtained state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the positive force of an obtained state while excluding causative formation or cosmic creation as the local sense.
topics.reason: The V4 branch range includes broad being and other branches, but the local copular frame selects predication; broader creation or causative claims are therefore narrowed.

topics.headline: state produces response
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's first verbal beat as the state that triggers the coming beat.
topics.reason: The local condition-apodosis architecture, not mere root cooccurrence, activates the state-to-response relation.

topics.headline: legal discourse echo as background
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the being-right construction sits inside Surah 24 legal argumentation without letting other legal-coming scenes control this parse.
topics.reason: The cited legal settings are useful as discourse background, but local grammar keeps the selected sense as a conditional copula.

words.gloss_range: preposition of advantage/possession forming the fronted predicate inside the condition
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) makes the condition about the right being for them or on their side. It governs the plural pronoun, not the right itself, so the clause is not a genitive ownership phrase. Because the prepositional predicate comes before the named right, the reader hears advantage first and only then the thing advantaging them.

topics.headline: right aligned for them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition encodes party advantage, not a neutral truth statement.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the phrase as the predicate of the copula and a dative advantage relation.

topics.headline: pronoun governed, right outside government
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition governs the group-pronoun while the right remains the clause subject.
topics.reason: The attachment rows distinguish the governed pronoun from the nominative subject.

topics.headline: benefit heard before right
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the compact beneficiary phrase is foregrounded before the right is named.
topics.reason: The local word order places the prepositional predicate before the subject, and the form rows preserve the compact phrase-level payoff.

words.gloss_range: attached 3mp pronoun referring to the same disputant group and placing them first as beneficiaries, then as later actors
words.prose: {{ar:هُمُ}} ({{tr:humu}}) keeps the same faction in view across the contrast with 24:48. Inside the beneficiary phrase it is not the subject of the copular verb; it is the group for whom the right works, and its full pronoun shape keeps that plural reference audible before the right is named. The later plural verb then lets the same referent become the implied actors, moving them from advantaged recipients to people who come.

topics.headline: same faction across the contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same group that resisted in 24:48 is being diagnosed here.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the pronoun referent from 24:47-48, and the CRITICAL rows preserve the continuity of the faction.

topics.headline: beneficiary before actor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the group first as beneficiaries of a favorable right, not as agents.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the pronoun the complement of the preposition, while the right remains subject.

topics.headline: beneficiary becomes implied comer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the role change from receiving advantage to acting on that advantage.
topics.reason: The later plural verb supplies a pro-dropped subject with the same referent, preserving the CRITICAL role-shift payoff.

topics.headline: audible plural hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the compact suffix still audibly marks the group before the right is named.
topics.reason: The form and sound rows add a small but concrete payoff to the pronoun's local prominence.

words.gloss_range: definite nominative right/truth as the delayed subject of the condition; locally a known favorable right or verdict with broader truth-register audible
words.root_gloss_range: firm truth, binding due, particular right, contested claim, and verification are relevant background branches; local grammar selects the definite right/verdict as subject, not a causative act of establishing truth
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَقُّ}} ({{tr:al-ḥaqqu}}) is the nominative subject that finally names what is for them. The definite form makes it a known right in the dispute-frame, while the root's range keeps truth, binding due, entitlement, and verdict-pressure together. Because it arrives after the beneficiary phrase, the ayah lets their advantage frame the right before the right is named; because it is a noun, not a causative verb, the right is the condition they welcome, not something they establish. It closes the condition and triggers the coming beat, echoes Surah 24's truth-and-due thread (24:25), moves from the judgment process in 24:48 to established right, and its tightened sound suits that firmness.

topics.headline: known right as subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the right is grammatically what obtains, and that it is definite rather than a vague claim.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as definite nominative subject, matching the CRITICAL rows.

topics.headline: right named after advantage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the group-interest phrase is heard before the right itself.
topics.reason: The local order is predicate before subject, preserving the CRITICAL payoff of delayed naming.

topics.headline: truth, right, and verdict pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local legal right still carries the weight of established binding truth.
topics.reason: V4 supports truth, due, and right branches, while the local legal frame narrows the selected sense toward a favorable right or verdict.

topics.headline: stable noun, not establishing act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the right as a stable clause participant rather than an action someone performs.
topics.reason: The local GERUND noun supports nominal stability; derivative establishing and construct-possession claims are kept as contrasts rather than selected parse.

topics.headline: binding due and entitlement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the right both binds the judgment and names what the party wants counted for them.
topics.reason: V4 branch evidence supports binding and entitlement pressure, and the local condition gives that pressure reader-facing value.

topics.headline: right triggers approach
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the right closes the condition and immediately triggers the action beat.
topics.reason: The local condition-apodosis structure, not cooccurrence alone, makes the right the trigger for coming.

topics.headline: Surah 24 truth echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this favorable right sits against Surah 24's wider truth-and-due thread, especially 24:25.
topics.reason: The concrete reference 24:25 is useful as an echo, but it is narrowed so it does not override the local legal condition.

topics.headline: firm sound texture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the tightened sound of the word that names the binding right.
topics.reason: The sound row carries a small but concrete payoff consistent with the semantic firmness of the selected branch.

topics.headline: judgment process to established right
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from the judgment scene in 24:48 to the favorable right in 24:49.
topics.reason: The boundary row has a concrete adjacent reference and coheres with the local legal frame.

words.gloss_range: jussive apodosis verb of coming/approach with no direct object and a directional complement
words.root_gloss_range: coming, arriving, bringing, giving, and event-arrival belong to the broader root family; local valency selects intransitive directional approach, not bringing or granting
words.prose: {{ar:يَأْتُوا}} ({{tr:yaʾtū}}) opens the consequence: once the right is for them, they come. The jussive form keeps this movement dependent on the condition, and the no-object directional frame selects approach toward the authority, ruling, or truth rather than bringing evidence or granting something. The same group that was beneficiary now becomes the plural actor, so advantage turns into visible motion and then into the final manner-state. Against the turning-aside posture of 24:48, this is frontal approach and procedural compliance; legal proof-bringing remains only a background contrast (24:13), the Surah opening supplies a loose revelation-to-response arc (24:1), and the later obedience formula sharpens the difference between opportunistic coming and principled obedience (24:51). The hamza onset gives the action word an audible pivot.

topics.headline: conditional consequence verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices their coming as the consequence of advantage, not an independent settled habit.
topics.reason: The verb is identified as the jussive apodosis, directly preserving the CRITICAL contingency claim.

topics.headline: approach, not bringing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root's broad range is narrowed to self-presentation toward a destination.
topics.reason: The local verb has no direct object and takes a directional complement, so bringing, granting, and object-delivery branches are narrowed out.

topics.headline: beneficiaries become actors
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same group moving from beneficiary status into active approach.
topics.reason: The finite plural morphology supplies a pro-dropped subject continuous with the earlier pronoun.

topics.headline: verb licenses final state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the coming verb sets up the final participial manner, not a bare arrival.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the final participle a circumstantial state attached to this motion verb.

topics.headline: approach reverses aversion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the bodily reversal from turning aside in 24:48 to approaching in 24:49.
topics.reason: The adjacent boundary contrast is concrete and locally supported by the shift into a coming verb.

topics.headline: approaching judgment when favored
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that coming functions as procedural compliance when the expected outcome favors them.
topics.reason: The local if-then frame activates the procedural reading; legal proof-bringing comparisons, including 24:13, remain background rather than local valency.

topics.headline: event-arrival pressure behind approach
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that compliance is what happens once advantage arrives, while physical/procedural approach remains primary.
topics.reason: The directional complement keeps approach primary, so event-arrival is retained only as a secondary pressure.

topics.headline: not granting or giving
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this form makes them come; it does not cast them as givers or granters.
topics.reason: The local surface is the coming verb with a directional complement, so the giving/granting contrast is useful only as an excluded branch.

topics.headline: Surah opening background
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a loose Surah 24 movement from revelation to response, while the local clause remains a judgment-approach scene.
topics.reason: The Surah opening reference 24:1 is retained as background; it does not determine the local sense.

topics.headline: hamza onset pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an audible catch where the condition turns into action.
topics.reason: The sound row has a concrete local payoff tied to the action-word pivot.

topics.headline: forward contrast with principled obedience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that conditional compliance here prepares a contrast with unqualified obedience in 24:51.
topics.reason: The row supplies a concrete later reference, 24:51, and the contrast coheres with the local conditional frame.

words.gloss_range: directional preposition plus 3ms suffix giving a definite but context-dependent destination
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَيْهِ}} ({{tr:ʾilayhi}}) supplies the destination of their coming. The endpoint is definite, but the suffix remains context-dependent: it can point back to the Messenger as judge from 24:48 or to the right just named. That ambiguity matters because their selective compliance concerns both authority and favorable truth or verdict, and the direction can extend into procedural loyalty when the result is favorable. Its position between the motion verb and the final manner word separates where they go from how they go, while the paired hamza onset across action and goal binds them as one approach sequence.

topics.headline: definite endpoint with live antecedents
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the destination can be the judging authority from 24:48 or the favorable right, and the wording keeps both pressures live.
topics.reason: Attachment cross-reference evidence explicitly marks the suffix antecedent as ambiguous, supporting the CRITICAL rows and preventing forced resolution.

topics.headline: directed approach, not bare arrival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the coming has a governed endpoint rather than remaining general arrival.
topics.reason: The attachment row identifies the suffix as the governed complement of the directional preposition.

topics.headline: direction extends to procedural loyalty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the movement toward the endpoint also signals a turn toward authority or right when favorable.
topics.reason: The local preposition is directional; allegiance language is retained as a procedural extension, not as a replacement of spatial/directional syntax.

topics.headline: destination before manner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's spatial logic: advantage is for them, then they move toward him or it, then their manner is named.
topics.reason: The word order places the destination phrase between the coming verb and final circumstantial state.

topics.headline: paired hamza onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated onset binding the action and goal as one approach sequence.
topics.reason: The sound row is retained as a small local payoff tied to the verb-destination sequence.

words.gloss_range: Form IV active participle in accusative circumstantial state; ready yielding compliance as the manner of their coming
words.root_gloss_range: yielding, submission, tractability, and prompt compliance are the active root range; locally it is human collective manner-state, not a separate finite action
words.prose: {{ar:مُذْعِنِينَ}} ({{tr:mudhʿinīna}}) closes the ayah on manner rather than motion. Grammatically it is an accusative circumstantial state describing the people who come, not the destination and not a second finite action; the masculine plural accusative marks the whole human group in that shared state. Lexically the rare root gathers yielding, tractability, and prompt compliance into one final posture, and the Form IV active participle makes the compliance feel adopted while still subordinate as manner: when the right favors them, the same group becomes collectively easy to lead. The final participial cadence lets that state linger, answers the prior closing participle in 24:48, and contrasts with the later principled obedience response (24:51).

topics.headline: coming in a state of submission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that submission is the manner of their coming, not a separate second action.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the word as a circumstantial accusative attached to the coming verb.

topics.headline: state belongs to the coming group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the submissive state characterizes the whole human group, not the endpoint.
topics.reason: Agreement and the circumstantial relation tie the participle to the implied plural subject.

topics.headline: tractable yielding compliance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word names ready, manageable yielding rather than generic obedience or mere arrival.
topics.reason: V4 supports the yielding-compliance branch, and the local condition gives the tractability image a specific self-interested setting.

topics.headline: adopted compliance in participial form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an active adopted posture of yielding, while the grammar keeps it subordinate as a state.
topics.reason: The active participial form supports adopted compliance; the topic is narrowed so it does not become an independent finite action or overstate reflexive causation.

topics.headline: single Quranic exposure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this rare root concentrates its Quranic force in this one exposure of selective compliance.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks the root as low occurrence with count one, supporting the hapax payoff.

topics.headline: ayah closes on manner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the semantic landing point is the quality of their approach.
topics.reason: The word is ayah-final and syntactically completes the consequence with a manner-state.

topics.headline: opposite closing participles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the paired endings of 24:48 and 24:49 as aversion versus compliant yielding.
topics.reason: The adjacent ayah contrast has a concrete reference and is reinforced by participial closure in both panels.

topics.headline: conditional submission versus obedience formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ready compliance here contrasts with the later principled obedience response in 24:51.
topics.reason: The forward contrast is retained with the concrete reference 24:51 and limited to discourse payoff.

topics.headline: final sound seals the state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the lingering final cadence on the state of compliance.
topics.reason: The sound rows add a concrete ayah-final payoff and do not conflict with grammar or lexical evidence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional وَإِن يَكُن لَّهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ governs the result يَأْتُوا إِلَيْهِ مُذْعِنِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A right's becoming present specifically for them switches on directed arrival and compliant behavior; the compliance is therefore benefit-conditioned before any context is consulted.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and presence in a time supply the conditional coming-into-force of the favorable state.
A right owned by its claimant supplies the advantage allocated to them and functions as the switch for approach.
Coming and arrival supply the observable movement toward the addressee once the condition is met.
Submission and tractable compliance supply the manner of arrival, making the favorable-condition response conspicuously frictionless.

changed_reading.before: They come submissively when truth is present.
changed_reading.after: Their arrival and submission are explicitly switched on when an enforceable advantage accrues to them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: In لَّهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ, the same focus noun can present fixed truth or a right belonging to a claimant, while لَهُم pulls the construction toward allocation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The truth and proprietary-right branches remain live together: the line does not merely ask whether a position is true, but exposes whether truth resolves in their favor. Their responsiveness is attached to the self-favoring face of truth.

activation_trace.role: Truth fixed against falsehood supplies the objective-merits reading that remains live.
A claimant's particular right supplies the allocated-interest reading sharpened by the dative pronoun.
Ready submission supplies the behavioral response whose selective attachment to favorable truth is being exposed.

changed_reading.before: They obey when they are correct.
changed_reading.after: They become responsive to truth precisely when truth takes the form of their own winning claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first fixes delimited obligations, repeatedly requires a claimant to bring witnesses, and uses the closely repeated construction in which witnesses are or are not 'for them.' This changes the focus right from a merely favorable opinion into a procedurally cognizable claim, and changes coming into an act of evidentiary production before authority.

activation_trace.role: The claimant-owned right supplies the focus entitlement whose procedural formation is sharpened by the earlier rules.
Arrival supplies the focus act now recast as presenting oneself and one's case to an adjudicating authority.
A precisely delimited imposition supplies the rule-bound legal environment in which a right becomes enforceable.
Bringing or producing something supplies the earlier procedural sense of the same root: a claim must arrive with evidence.
The presence or absence of witnesses in the repeated 'be for them' construction supplies a grammatical precursor to the focus condition.
Knowledge-bearing testimony supplies the mechanism by which an asserted position can become a recognized right.

structural_cues: 24:1 declares the surah's norms imposed and delimited.
24:4 and 24:6 make production and configuration of testimony determine a claim's procedural standing.
The repeated ك و ن + لَهُم construction in 24:6 makes the focus conditional sound like part of the same legal grammar.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fixed rules, required evidentiary production, and the repeated 'be for them' construction. I infer that these rules mediate how the focus right becomes actionable and how coming enacts a case. A live alternative is that 24:49 refers only to favorable merits, not formal admissibility.

changed_reading.before: They approach whenever they believe the truth favors them.
changed_reading.after: They readily submit to the forum when the rule-and-evidence structure has matured into an enforceable claim for them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus points from 'the right for them' toward 'him,' but the wider surah names Allah as the manifest Truth, assigns Him sovereignty, makes Him the destination, and returns everyone to Him. The subjects reverse that hierarchy: their movement toward authority depends on truth first moving into their possession.

activation_trace.role: A particular right held by a claimant supplies the local possessive pole 'for them.'
Directed arrival supplies the focus vector whose motive changes under the wider ownership frame.
Fixed truth against falsehood supplies both the true due and the manifest Truth that exceed any litigant's favorable share.
Sovereignty supplies the encompassing ownership within which a private right is only a subordinate allocation.
Becoming toward an ultimate outcome supplies a destination independent of whether an interim judgment benefits them.
Return to a prior or governing point supplies the final direction that corrects their selfward orientation.

structural_cues: 24:25 places two uses of ٱلْحَقّ inside divine recompense and disclosure.
24:42 pairs divine sovereignty with movement toward Allah as destination.
24:64 closes with return to Him and disclosure of deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the contrast among a right 'for them,' Allah as Truth and sovereign, and movement or return to Him. I infer a reversal in motivational direction: they approach the authority only after truth points selfward. A live alternative is that these possessive and directional echoes provide theology without functioning as a critique of the focus pronouns.

changed_reading.before: Their fault is simply refusing an unfavorable verdict.
changed_reading.after: Their deeper inversion is to treat truth as authoritative only after it has become theirs, although ownership and destination in the surah run toward Allah.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the dispute sequence, creatures worship in known patterns, birds align, all sovereignty has one destination, creatures move in their given modes, and guidance leads to a straight road. Against that ordered mobility, the focus subjects can move compliantly but let private advantage choose when their route activates.

activation_trace.role: Conditional occurrence supplies the unstable on-off condition governing these subjects' movement.
Arrival supplies the human movement compared with the stable courses established immediately before it.
Compliance supplies an available capacity for ordered motion that private interest selectively releases.
Worship through praise supplies a creation-wide pattern of responsive action rather than result-contingent participation.
Alignment on an even line supplies visible, stable ordering in bodily posture.
Universal sovereignty supplies the authority under which all these movements occur.
Movement toward an outcome supplies the stable destination against which self-favoring approach is measured.
Walking and bodily movement supply diverse but given modes of locomotion, each actually enacted.
Gentle direction toward road and truth supplies guidance not selected by a litigant's payoff.
The straight road supplies the invariant course immediately preceding the subjects' conditional approach.

structural_cues: 24:41-46 forms an extended sequence of known posture, destination, bodily movement, and guided road immediately before 24:47-49.
The focus result clause is also bodily and directional, but its protasis makes the route depend on private benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered creaturely action, a single destination, varied locomotion, and a straight guided road. I infer that this sequence makes the focus group's payoff-switched movement an ethical anti-pattern within ordered creation. A live alternative is that 24:41-46 only establishes divine power and guidance before the immediate courtroom polemic.

changed_reading.before: The ayah reports a local courtroom inconsistency.
changed_reading.after: The ayah also presents an anomalous mode of motion: these humans can move in compliance, but unlike the ordered courses around them, private benefit selects when they do.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence first opposes spoken belief and obedience to subsequent turning away, then rejects strenuous oaths in favor of recognizable obedience and divine knowledge of deeds. The focus complicates even that speech-action test: actual coming and submission can still be counterfeit evidence when their occurrence is perfectly aligned with self-interest.

activation_trace.role: Actual arrival supplies conduct that initially appears more probative than a verbal profession.
Visible compliance supplies enacted obedience whose motive the condition exposes.
Uttered speech supplies the profession of faith and obedience that later conduct tests.
Claimed obedience supplies the verbal category against which focus compliance is measured.
Turning away supplies the contradictory action that invalidates the preceding profession.
A formally apportioned oath supplies intensified speech that is nevertheless refused as proof.
Recognizable obedience supplies the demanded alternative to verbal insistence.
Knowledge of a matter's interior supplies scrutiny of motive beneath both statement and performance.
Intentional deed supplies the behavioral field known beyond their oaths.

structural_cues: 24:49 places genuine bodily approach inside an explicitly self-favoring condition.
24:53 refuses emphatic oaths and places known action under divine interior knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a progression from speech to contradictory action, then from oath to known deed. I infer a further diagnostic step: even an obedient-looking deed is inconclusive unless it survives adverse interest. A live alternative is that the focus coming is simply open hypocrisy and is not meant to revise the speech-action test itself.

changed_reading.before: Their words are false, while actual obedient conduct would reveal sincerity.
changed_reading.after: Even actual arrival and submission fail as evidence of sincerity when the action occurs only on the winning side of a dispute.

context_deltas.mechanism: A summons to judgment produces side-turning refusal; the focus supplies the counterfactual condition under which the same group arrives submissively; the next ayah denies judicial bias as their excuse and identifies obstruction of right, while the following ayah defines faithful response as obedience to the same summons. The mechanism is selective acceptance of jurisdiction by expected outcome.

activation_trace.role: A claimant's owned right supplies the favorable expected disposition that controls participation.
Arrival supplies acceptance of the forum once its expected disposition favors them.
Ready submission supplies their low-resistance posture inside the favorable forum.
A call that draws by speech supplies the authoritative summons whose force they treat as optional.
Judgment between people supplies the institutional purpose of their approach or refusal.
Turning one's side away supplies the bodily refusal contrasted with the focus movement toward him.
Deviation in judgment supplies the proposed fairness-based excuse that the sequence rejects.
Withholding or obstructing a right supplies the sequence's diagnosis of the refusers rather than of the judge.
Obedience supplies the invariant response to summons that exposes their outcome-dependent substitute.

structural_cues: 24:48, 24:49, and 24:51 repeat summons or approach to the same adjudicating authority with sharply different responses.
24:50 explicitly tests and rejects fear of judicial deviation before assigning wrongdoing to the refusers.
The protasis of 24:49 isolates favorable entitlement as the variable that reverses refusal into submission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies summons, adjudication, refusal, favorable entitlement, denied fear of bias, and the obedient comparator. I infer that expected outcome, rather than confidence in forum fairness, controls their recognition of jurisdiction. A live alternative is that the ayah diagnoses broad hypocrisy without a narrower forum-selection mechanism.

changed_reading.after: They treat the adjudicating authority as binding only when it is expected to deliver their right, turning submission into outcome-contingent forum selection.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, rightful mobility is reciprocal: do not enter without authorization, return openly when told, remain in a gathering until permission, and do not slip away under cover. The focus group's defect is thus not simple immobility; they approach openly when advantage invites them but do not accept authority over both entry and exit.

activation_trace.role: Coming supplies one direction of social movement whose legitimacy the context makes reciprocal.
Submission supplies the compliant manner that should govern adverse retreat as well as advantageous approach.
Entry into an interior supplies a concrete approach whose permissibility depends on another party's boundary.
Authorization supplies the external condition for rightful entry rather than a self-declared benefit.
Open return supplies compliant movement under an adverse answer, the behavior missing from the focus group's pattern.
A matter that gathers people supplies the shared obligation from which departure also requires authorization.
Repeated permission supplies accountable exit from collective duty and makes authority govern both directions.
Gentle hidden extraction supplies the covert opposite of accountable coming or return.
Using another as cover supplies concealment that turns departure into evasion of authority.

structural_cues: 24:27-29 regulates approach, entry, denial, and return around another party's boundary.
24:62-63 regulates remaining, licensed departure, and covert withdrawal around a collective matter.
24:49 supplies the inverse asymmetry: conspicuously easy approach only when the outcome belongs to them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rules for authorized entry, obedient return, licensed departure, and concealed withdrawal. I infer a surah-wide ethics of reciprocal movement and read the focus as one-sided mobility under self-interest. A live alternative is that the household and assembly rules are parallel conduct domains rather than activators of the adjudication scene.

changed_reading.before: They fail by staying away from authority when a case may go against them.
changed_reading.after: They fail by recognizing authority over only the advantageous direction of movement: they come readily for gain but do not let permission and duty govern retreat, remaining, and exit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The activation is surprising because it links two distant uses and different branches of ع ر ض: worldly share and turning one's side away. It remains valid as a cross-branch motion-and-payoff model anchored in لَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ, يَأْتُوا, and the immediate مُعْرِضُونَ. Downstream prose should present it as an exploratory compass image, not claim that the two contextual uses are lexically identical or concern the same actors.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus makes advantageous possession govern movement toward him, while the preceding ayah describes bodily orientation away.

activation_trace.role: A right belonging to them supplies the payoff pole toward which their behavior turns.
Coming supplies the bodily vector activated when the payoff pole is favorable.
A transient worldly commodity or share supplies the material-interest pole of the exploratory compass.
Turning the side away supplies the opposite bodily vector when adjudication does not promise that interest.

changed_reading.before: They alternate between turning away and coming according to a favorable verdict.
changed_reading.after: Their bodily orientation acts like a compass for private share: expected gain turns them toward the forum, while its absence turns their side away.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The activation is surprising because it imports the earlier mirage's appetite-driven approach into a legal scene. It remains anchored in the focus roots for owned right and coming, and in 24:39's explicit apparent water and arrival. Downstream prose must say that the analogy diagnoses the mover's expectation, not that a valid right, the authority, or the eventual judgment is itself unreal.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A right becoming 'for them' is the perceived benefit that makes them come.

activation_trace.role: A claimant-owned right supplies the anticipated benefit that attracts movement.
Coming and arrival supply the focus motion recast as appetite-responsive approach.
A mirage shining like water supplies a perceived payoff capable of drawing motion before its reality is tested.
Ordinary water supplies the desired benefit projected onto the apparent destination.
Coming and reaching supply the contextual motion prompted by anticipated satisfaction.

changed_reading.before: Their coming proves only that they expect to win.
changed_reading.after: Their coming can be read as appetite-driven arrival toward a perceived benefit; it reveals what draws them, not an allegiance to truth independent of gain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The activation is surprising because it combines the focus branch of ح ق ق for a camel mature enough to carry with the compliant-camel scope of ذ ع ن, then lets 24:54's assigned burdens activate the image. It remains doubly anchored in focus branches and a nearby burden citation. Downstream prose should label it a material diagnostic image, never an etymological translation of ٱلْحَقّ or مُذْعِنِينَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins ٱلْحَقّ and مُذْعِنِينَ in a condition where the subjects become readily tractable only for a load that benefits them.

activation_trace.role: An animal reaching the stage fit for carrying supplies readiness to bear a load as the material image of a matured claim.
Tractable submission, including the branch's docile-mount scope, supplies the low-resistance carrier posture.
Bearing an assigned trust or burden supplies the nearby contrast: each party carries what is charged to it regardless of private payoff.

changed_reading.before: They are tractable when a right belongs to them.
changed_reading.after: In a contained burden-bearing image, they become an easy mount only when the load is their matured entitlement, while the surrounding command assigns burdens that must be carried without such advantage.

strongest_changes: The early evidence rules and repeated 'be for them' construction make ٱلْحَقّ a procedurally established entitlement and make coming an act of presenting a case.
The wider ownership and destination sequence exposes a possessive reversal: they move toward authority only after truth has first moved into their favor.
The immediate summons, judgment, refusal, and denied-bias sequence identifies outcome-contingent forum selection rather than principled fear of injustice.
The speech-and-oath sequence changes the diagnostic standard: even enacted submission is inconclusive when it occurs only under favorable interest.
The permission sequences make their fault one-sided mobility under authority, not mere failure to appear.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet activated exact grammatical and material links that a generic hypocrisy reading would flatten: ك و ن + لَهُم around witnesses and right, the evidentiary 'bringing' branch of ء ت ي, the shift from a right for them to Allah as Truth, owner, and destination, the two ع ر ض branches joining worldly share to bodily turning, and the contained camel-and-burden image across ح ق ق, ذ ع ن, and ح م ل.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus ٱلْحَقّ can continue to carry objective truth, favorable merits, and formally enforceable private right without forcing one sense to eliminate the others.
The referent of إِلَيْهِ is locally the summoned adjudicating authority, but the wider destination language can orient the reading without resolving the pronoun differently.
The creation-order and permission models are coherent whole-surah activations, but the immediate adjudication sequence remains the cleaner causal frame.
The ع ر ض, mirage, and burden-bearing outliers should remain qualified exploratory images rather than lexical claims.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Their compliance is indexed to ownership of the outcome.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed-ayah `ح ق ق` B002 is a due obligation and B003 a particular owned claim; `ء ت ي` B001 is coming/arriving and B003 approaching through a proper way; `ذ ع ن` B001 is yielding compliance that may include haste. **Structural cue:** 24:47-48 show declaration followed by withdrawal; this ayah reverses the motion only under `لهم الحق`, and 24:50-54 contrast suspected bias with genuine hearing, obedience, and distributed responsibility. **Assigned role:** `لهم` makes the right beneficiary-specific, coming supplies the bodily evidence, and yielding describes the suddenly available compliance. **Abductive move:** the packet supplies condition, favorable claim, and approach; I infer anticipated personal gain → procedural cooperation, revealing an instrumental rather than stable submission. **Reading change:** their problem is not inability to obey but making obedience a transaction contingent on possession of the result.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 24:50-51 corrected any reading of `مذعنين` as genuine submission: the questions expose projected mistrust, while true believers' hearing and obedience are not conditioned on owning the result.

identity_judgment.rationale: Bu dal, kanıtta tek üretken kök çekirdeğine indirgenmeyen sınırlı adlandırma malzemesini taşır. Yapısal bölme şartı koşmadan, yalnız verilen biçim ve bağlam sınırı içinde kontrollü adlandırma kümesi olarak tutulmalıdır.

facets.statement: Bir kullanım iki kemiğin birleştiği eklem yerini gösterir.

Ayrı bir söz öbeği örümcek ağını adlandırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi genel güç veya bütün hayvan gelişimini değil, dişi devenin semirmesini, sürü hayvanlarının yağlanmasını ve semizliğin son düzeyine ulaşmasını anlatır. Dal bu özgül beden değişimine göre daraltılmalıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ekin ve hurmanın ürünü, gelişmesi ve bol verimi ile suyun çoğalmasını destekler. Çalkalanan tulumdan yağın çıkması ise yalnız ayrı kalıbın kaynak ifadesiyle açıklanabilen, çekirdeğe bağlı olmayan bir kullanımdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi, bir yönlendirmeye kolayca eşlik edebilme ile ona boyun eğip uyma yönlerini tek çekirdekte toplar. Kişinin karşı koymadan uyması, başından kolayca yönlendirilen dişi deve ve uyma ile birlikte çabuk davranma örnekleri bu dal kimliğini doğrular.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam salt hız ya da dıştan zorlanma değildir; yönlendirmeye direnmeden boyun eğme ve onun gereğini yapma esastır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, genel boyun eğip uyma biçimleriyle yalnız dişi deve için kurulan söz öbeğini birlikte içerir. Tanım genel çekirdeği verir; hayvana ilişkin başından kolay yönlendirilme özelliği yalın biçimlerin tümüne yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin ya da canlının bir yönlendirmeye direnmeden boyun eğip uyması, yönetenin veya buyruğun ardınca kolayca gitmesidir. Bazı kullanımlarda bu uyma, isteneni çabucak yapmayı da içerir; hız tek başına bu anlamı vermez.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye, buyruğa ya da yönlendirmeye karşı koymadan boyun eğip onun gereğini yapma.
Boyun eğme, isteneni çabucak yerine getirmeye kadar belirginleşebilir; buradaki çabukluk uyma ile birlikte bulunur.
İnsan için söylenene uyma, kabul etme, alçalma ve karşı koymama tutumlarını birlikte anlatabilir.
Dişi deve için başından kolayca yönlendirilen, güdenine karşı koymadan giden uysal hayvanı niteler.
